remarks: Don't miss this beautiful home nestled on a quiet dead-end street in the highly desirable Cranbury area! Offering 4-5 spacious bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and over 2,600 square feet of living space, this home is designed for both comfortable everyday living and effortless entertaining. The main level features an open-concept kitchen and dining area, perfect for gatherings, along with a cozy three-season sunroom complete with operable skylights-a bright and inviting space to relax year-round. Step outside to a fully fenced, level backyard, ideal for entertaining, pets, or simply enjoying the outdoors. The finished basement provides flexible living space with excellent potential for an in-law setup or possible income opportunity, adding even more value and versatility. Schedule your private showing today and discover everything this exceptional home has to offer!
